title: BIS advanced computing controls
summary: The October 2022 rule introduced controls on specified advanced computing and semiconductor manufacturing items and covered end uses. Check the original DATES section for provision-specific timing.

title: BIS advanced computing updates
summary: The October 2023 rule updated earlier thresholds and end-use controls. The published text sets out provision-specific dates and later changes may affect current operation.

title: AI Diffusion framework
summary: BIS published a framework for certain advanced computing items and model weights. The November 2026 rule formalized rescission of the 2025 framework.

title: H20 export-license notification
summary: NVIDIA disclosed earlier U.S. notices about a license requirement for certain H20 exports and said the government had told it the requirement would apply indefinitely.

title: BIS non-enforcement announcement
summary: Commerce announced that BIS would refrain from enforcing the AI Diffusion Rule and would pursue rescission. The formal rule change came later.

title: Conditional H200-class license review
summary: For qualifying exports from the United States to China or Macau, BIS revised its review policy to case-by-case under specified conditions. Individual licenses and later changes need separate checks.

title: Record-preservation request
summary: Senators asked federal officials to preserve records concerning NVIDIA-related export decisions. The request is an oversight milestone.

title: BIS announces remote-access rule
summary: BIS announced an interim final rule before publication in the Federal Register.

title: House transcribed interview with Jensen Huang
summary: Committee chairs announced a transcribed interview with Huang for December 1. Look for a new notice or official record to confirm any change or occurrence.

title: House transcribed interview with Tim Teter
summary: Committee chairs announced a December 2 transcribed interview with NVIDIA’s general counsel. An official notice or record is needed to establish subsequent developments.

title: Remote access to advanced semiconductors
summary: The interim final rule addresses certain remote access to computing power and adds specified licensing requirements. Its dates section sets a January 19 comment deadline. Read provision-specific timing in the rule.

title: Investigative subpoena to NVIDIA
summary: California’s Attorney General announced serving a subpoena seeking information. The release describes an investigation in progress.

title: House ranking member requests a public hearing
summary: The ranking member asked for a public House hearing. The request has a different procedural status from the previously scheduled transcribed interviews.

title: Senator Booker seeks information
summary: The senator asked NVIDIA’s board chair about reinstatement and competition concerns. This entry tracks the request and future public responses.

title: Public Senate hearing on export controls
summary: The committee calendar listed Huang as a witness for December 3 at 10 a.m. Washington time. Check the official listing and posted materials for updates.

title: BIS adds seven entities to the Entity List
summary: BIS published the addition of seven entities in Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand. The rule dates the action to November 23 and explains the agency’s advanced-computing diversion-risk rationale.

title: December 2024 semiconductor export-control refinements
summary: The rule added foreign-produced direct product provisions and revised controls on advanced computing and semiconductor manufacturing items. Its Dates section gives separate provision-specific compliance timing.

title: Advanced computing due diligence measures
summary: The interim final rule introduced new due diligence measures for advanced computing integrated circuits. The rule distinguishes January 16 effectiveness from the January 31 compliance date for new text.
